name: bag_of_holding_returned_forgets_what_its_earlier_life_exiled
notes: Bug hunt 2026-11-17 (mapper M3, Hoarding Dragon's draft; wave E1). Bag of Holding: 'Whenever you discard a card, exile that card from your graveyard. / {2}, {T}: Draw a card, then discard a card. / {4}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Return all cards exiled with this artifact to their owner's hand.' The Bag loots Spare A away (exiled by its trigger), then returns to its owner's hand and is put onto the battlefield again: a new object (CR 400.7). It loots Spare B away, and on seat 0's next turn its sacrifice returns the cards exiled with this object only (CR 607.2a): Spare B, not Spare A. Hand: 2, +1 -1, +1 the Bag, -1 the Bag, +1 -1, +1 the turn's draw, +1 Spare B = 4. Failed before the fix: IS_EXILED_WITH_SOURCE read every exile the card's handle caused, across its lives, and Spare A came back too (hand 5).
